input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: HEALTH AND DIGITAL EXECUTIVE AGENCY (HADEA) , HADEA - HEALTH AND DIGITAL EXECUTIVE AGENCY. Summary: Implementation of the New Soho Regulation: Training and Networking of Soho Competent Authorities- Staff for Oversight. Description: The subject of this call for tenders is “Implementation of the new SoHO Regulation: training and networking of SoHO Competent Authorities- staff for oversight”. The training activities are addressed in particular to inspectors, vigilance officers and preparation process assessors, for strengthening the implementation of oversight in the field of Substances of Human Origin (SoHO) in the EU Member States, EFTA countries and candidate countries. The expected results aim at increasing and standardising the competences of inspectors, vigilance officers and assessors in this sector across the EU as well as building a network of junior and senior competent authority staff, facilitating possible joint inspections, joint assessment of preparation processes and peer audits among Member States, and reinforcing trust between them to facilitate the exchange of SoHO. <br> Doc Title: Implementation of the new SoHO Regulation: training and networking of SoHO Competent Authorities- staff for oversight <br> Contract Type: services. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: EIT DIGITAL IVZW. Summary: Training Development Services in Ai and Data Science for National Competition Authorities in Eu Member States. Description: EIT Digital seeks a Contractor that cooperates with EIT Digital to create, develop and deliver training plans for National Competition Authorities (NCA). In the field of Law enforcement, the National Competition Authorities (NCA) face growing challenges due to evolving digital markets, platform dynamics, data-driven business models, and algorithmic pricing. The goal is to equip the NCAs with the capacity to address competition issues in the digital economy using modern tools (AI, data science), methodologies, and a shared knowledge base. The purpose of this assignment is to develop a training programme that enables NCAs to effectively address anti-competitive behaviour. The Contractor will design and deliver training sessions through multiple formats including asynchronous e-learning modules and hands-on labs (face-to-face or online). To further knowledge transfer, the contractor will also develop a Train the Trainer programme to prepare selected points of contact to serve as internal trainers within each NCA. Through this procedure, EIT Digital aims to identify a suitable Contractor with proven expertise in capacity building in digital science, AI and competition law enforcement. <br> Doc Title: Training Development Services in AI and Data Science for National Competition Authorities in EU Member States <br> Contract Type: services. input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT, COMM - DIRECTORATE-GENERAL FOR COMMUNICATION. Summary: Implementation of the European Parliament Training Programme for Young European Journalists in France.. Description: The overarching service required is the organisation and implementation of a training programme on EU issues, with the purpose of raising awareness of young journalists, working for EU-based media outlets, regarding European affairs in general and Parliament-related topics in particular. The training programme aims at contributing to a better understanding of how the EU works, and at raising awareness about the importance of the Parliament, parliamentary democracy, as well as the values it stands for. It will include a module in Paris (or in another city in France) once or twice per year (first module), followed by a module in Brussels or Strasbourg (second module) for a limited number of journalists selected among participants in the first module. The target of this training are professionals in the beginning of their journalistic career, based in EU member states, in their capacity as key multipliers and informed relays. The following specific services should be included in the contractor-s offer: •Organisation of the programme (first module); •Selection of participants (first and second modules); •Communication and outreach activities. <br> Doc Title: Implementation of the European Parliament Training Programme for young European journalists in France. <br> Contract Type: services. Summary: Stakeholders Engagement and Community Management. Description: A new procurement procedure will be launched by EACEA for the establishment of a framework contract on stakeholders engagement and community management, to ensure the continuous availability of the services and sustain cooperation with stakeholders- groups and the governance of these initiatives. This action will contribute to an effective implementation of communities in the field of education and training, such as the one for adult learning in Europe, the one related to European School Education Platform and the one linked to the European Student Card initiative. The objective of this call for tender is the “Provision of services to support Community management in the fields of the Erasmus+ Programme.
